Lions live together in big families called prides!
Elephants are the biggest animals that live on land!
Giraffes are the tallest animals in the whole world!
Every zebra has its very own pattern of stripes!
Gorillas make a cozy new bed of leaves every night!
Hippos stay cool by spending most of the day in the water!
Leopards are super climbers and love to rest up in trees!
Crocodiles can hold their breath under the water for a long time!
A rhino's horn is made of the same stuff as your fingernails!
Flamingos are pink because of the tiny shrimp and plants they eat!
In Cameroon, people say Bonjour! It means hello in French.
Roasted corn is a yummy snack in Cameroon!
In Nigeria, people say Sannu! It means hello in Hausa.
Jollof rice is a favourite food in Nigeria!
In Ghana, people say Akwaaba! It means welcome in Twi.
Ghana grows lots of cocoa beans, used to make chocolate!
In Kenya, people say Jambo! It means hello in Swahili.
Ugali is a soft maize dish that people in Kenya love to eat!
In South Africa, people say Sawubona! It means hello in Zulu.
A braai is a barbecue where families grill meat outside!
